description: A ready-made build for one bike, model year and style (first-mods, carbon-street, track-day, track-only, budget-track). Returns the parts with typical prices and fitment notes, what Unstocked does not list for that bike and year, and a link that opens the build on unstocked.bike. Give the rider that link.

bike.description: Bike slug or name, e.g. "yamaha-r7", "R7" or "2026 Yamaha R7".

style.description: first-mods, carbon-street, track-day, track-only or budget-track. Plain words work too ("racing", "carbon", "first mods").

year.description: Model year, e.g. 2026. Without it the newest model years are used; ask the rider if it matters.

name: get_build
title: Get a ready-made build
